title: spring.ratelimit.redis
description: The Redis-backed counter store's single block. Its presence turns the starter on; client names the *goredis.Client bean whose Redis instance holds the shared rate-limit budgets. No other key belongs under spring.ratelimit.redis.

client.description: Name of the *goredis.Client bean (provided by starter-go-redis under spring.go-redis.instances.<name>) whose Redis instance backs the shared counters. Required; an empty value fails wiring.
